postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned Georgian Post postcode-finder receipt or separately permitted release establishes a four-digit assignment to the returned locality or delivery context at its capture time. Four-digit syntax, an addressing example, post-office location or locality name does not establish current allocation, address membership or deliverability.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: No nationwide official Georgian postcode-polygon source is assumed. A rights-cleared, versioned NAPR/NSDI address-membership surface may be published only as derived with members, exclusions, method, uncertainty and source releases. Post-office points, registered parcels, settlements, municipalities, buffers and Voronoi cells never become official postcode perimeters.
postal_system.address_rule: Exact address display requires a permitted NAPR Address Registry or NSDI Address Layer identifier, Georgian-script locator, named geographic object, hierarchy, status, validity, release-specific access licence and digest, plus separately pinned Georgian Post assignment evidence.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires an explicit distributable address-building relationship, common authoritative identifier or reviewed crosswalk to an NSDI registered-building feature. A cadastral parcel, footprint, containment or proximity match is candidate-only.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Regions, autonomous republics, municipalities and settlements remain separately sourced context. They do not create postcode membership, Georgian Post service coverage or address identity.
postal_system.service_status_rule: Postal assignment, post-office operation, route availability, postcode-finder availability and delivery eligibility are time-stamped operational assertions separate from geometry, address identity and administrative context.
postal_system.territory_rule: Postal assignment, language, locality name, nearest feature and routing availability never determine sovereignty or a legal boundary. Temporarily occupied or otherwise coverage-limited areas remain explicit gaps unless a separately pinned boundary policy and source-specific evidence support the requested assertion.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal assignment, address, building, explicit link, derived surface, administration and service validity when supplied.
temporal_model.known_time: Publication, lookup capture, NSDI metadata issue, ingest, licence review, correction and release timestamps retained independently.
temporal_model.history_rule: New Georgian Post, NAPR, NSDI or GeoStat evidence appends versioned assertions. No refresh rewrites older evidence, converts a point into a perimeter or silently fills a territorial coverage gap.

quality_gates.pass: Every four-digit code references a permitted Georgian Post receipt or release with locality or delivery context, capture time, interface/terms version and digest.
Every derived surface retains address members, exclusions, method, parameters, uncertainty, validation metrics, source releases, access licences, validity and digest and is never labelled official.
Each exact address retains a NAPR/NSDI identifier, Georgian locator and hierarchy, status, validity, release-specific licence, schema, CRS and digest, with postal assignment checked separately.
An exact building has an explicit distributable relation, common authoritative identifier or reviewed crosswalk; parcels, footprints, containment and proximity never silently substitute.
Every Georgian Post, NAPR, NSDI or GeoStat artifact pins its exact holder, access licence, attribution, schema, coverage, vintage, territorial policy, CRS and digest.
Coverage gaps and disputed or temporarily occupied areas remain explicit; postal evidence never assigns sovereignty or fills them from nearest data.
No addressee, resident, owner, rightsholder, tenant, occupant, title, restriction, phone, credential or delivery instruction is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, identifiers, geometry semantics, coverage and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with complete lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, licence, freshness, coverage and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
